_comment: Keys are the anchor IDs (ANCHOR_ID in the anchor sketch, ANCHORS[] in uwb_tag). Positions in metres on the floor plan: measure them with a tape. bias_m is subtracted from every range of that anchor (antenna delay error): measured - true distance at a known spot. map_size_m: side of the square map view in metres, centred on the anchors (remove it to fit the anchors).
